department: School of Life Sciences and Sustainability

deadline.value: Fall applications (preferred) are due January 10, 2027; all components must be received by then to be competitive.
deadline.quote: Fall (preferred) Jan 10 TOEFL, IELTS or equivalent for international students

gre_subject.value: The catalog does not mention a GRE Subject test.

supervisor.value: Applicants are strongly encouraged to contact potential research advisers before applying.
supervisor.quote: Applicants are strongly encouraged to contact potential research advisers prior to submitting application materials

funding.value: Applicants who name an adviser get preference for funding, but the catalog does not say most students are funded.
funding.quote: Individuals who have identified a research adviser will be given preference for admittance and funding

entry_route.value: The catalog requires an accredited degree that prepares students for life-science graduate study.
entry_route.quote: requires graduation from an accredited college or university or its equivalent with a degree that is preparative for graduate-level study in the life sciences

toefl_min.value: The program asks for a TOEFL minimum of 100 (test format not stated), above the university's 80.
toefl_min.quote: For international applicants, satisfactory scores from a standardized test, such as the TOEFL (a minimum score of 100) or IELTS (minimum band scores of 7.0)

ielts_min.value: The program asks for an IELTS band of 7.0, above the university's 6.5.

notes: Catalog only; the VCU Life Sciences pages were not fetched. The same PhD covers the bioinformatics and genome sciences, forensic science, and behavioral and statistical genetics concentrations.
